translations.web: But a certain one of those who stood by drew his sword, and struck the servant of the high priest, and cut off his ear.
translations.bsb: And one of the bystanders drew his sword and struck the servant of the high priest, cutting off his ear.
translations.kjv: And one of them that stood by drew a sword, and smote a servant of the high priest, and cut off his ear.
translations.asv: But a certain one of them that stood by drew his sword, and smote the servant of the high priest, and struck off his ear.
